method: Built-in ImageGen edit using native SketchUp geometry extraction

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. IMAGE 1 is the render to edit. LOCK all HOUSE PIXELS, architecture, camera, roof, doors, windows, decks, walls and sky. DO NOT change camera to image2. Images 2 and 3 are read-only reference for GROUND FOOTPRINT ONLY from actual SketchUp geometry, not building/roof appearance. Edit ONLY ground hardscape shape/material and neighboring lawn in image1. Keep distant trees small, as existing.
User wants exact model paving: model material Asphalt_06_1K appears medium gray matte fine asphalt aggregate, NOT pale concrete. NO slab joints or huge aggregate. Preserve all rest of image1.
Replace existing broad pale driveway with correctly dimensioned L-shaped medium-gray asphalt. At house: broad motor court between inner right garage wall and entry steps, roughly image x580..1020. Front neck is only 47.5% of that court width, along its RIGHT side immediately in front of entry door. LEFT 52.5% of former broad mouth MUST become lawn, large rectangular lawn notch extending from lawn in front of garage. This is a rectangular L footprint, no broad trapezoid, no outward flare. The front neck's left edge aligns roughly with LEFT stone pillar of entry portal (image x810), its right edge aligns with RIGHT edge of entry steps (image x1020). Project parallel edges naturally in same camera as image1; do not flare width 3x. Wide section extends to inward-facing garage doors at left, stays on right of garage front facade. Along central wall left of entry retain narrow grass strip between wall and motor court. Make narrow drive mouth reach foreground boundary/street. This sharp right-hand neck and large left grass notch are crucial.
All asphalt boundaries straight/right angled in world space per model. Existing building and camera must remain pixel-for-pixel intact, including original SIMPLE smooth hip roof silhouette, not roofs from reference2. Photorealistic, no labels.
